name_zh: 广州汽车集团股份有限公司

key_facts.value_en: June 1997 (predecessor Guangzhou Automobile Group Co., Ltd.)
key_facts.value_zh: 1997 年 6 月（前身广州汽车集团有限公司）
国有控股（广州市属国企）

key_facts.value_en: Guangzhou SASAC (via Guangzhou Automobile Industry Group)
key_facts.value_zh: 广州市国资委（通过广州汽车工业集团）

key_facts.label_en: Net profit attributable to shareholders (latest fiscal year)

key_facts.label_zh: 最近一年海外销量（自主品牌）
key_facts.value_zh: 近 13 万辆（出口终端销量）

history.event_en: Guangzhou Automobile Works forms Guangzhou Peugeot Automobile Co. with France's Peugeot, one of Guangzhou's first passenger-car joint ventures.
history.event_zh: 广州汽车制造厂与法国标致合资组建广州标致汽车公司，为广州最早的乘用车合资企业之一。

history.event_en: Predecessor Guangzhou Automobile Group Co., Ltd. is registered as a wholly state-owned company (6 June), consolidating Guangzhou's scattered auto assets.
history.event_zh: 前身广州汽车集团有限公司注册成立（6 月 6 日，国有独资），整合广州分散的汽车国有资产。

history.event_en: Guangzhou Honda Automobile Co., Ltd. is established with Honda.
history.event_zh: 与本田合资成立广州本田汽车有限公司。

history.event_en: Guangzhou Toyota Motor Co., Ltd. is established with Toyota.
history.event_zh: 与丰田合资成立广州丰田汽车有限公司。

history.event_en: The group is restructured by overall conversion into a joint-stock company, Guangzhou Automobile Group Co., Ltd., and completes business registration on 28 June.
history.event_zh: 集团整体改制为股份有限公司，变更为现名称，并于 6 月 28 日完成工商变更登记。

history.event_en: Lists H-shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (02238) by privatising Denway Motors and listing by introduction.
history.event_zh: 通过私有化骏威汽车、以介绍方式在香港联交所主板上市（H 股，02238）。

history.event_en: Launches the self-owned brand Trumpchi (GAC Motor); its first model, the GA5 sedan, rolls off the line.
history.event_zh: 发布首个自主品牌传祺，首款车型传祺 GA5 下线。

history.event_en: Lists A-shares on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (601238) through a share-swap absorption of GAC Changfeng, becoming the first large state-controlled auto group with overall A+H listing.
history.event_zh: 通过换股吸收合并广汽长丰在上交所上市（A 股，601238），成为首家 A+H 股整体上市的大型国有控股汽车集团。

history.event_en: Establishes GAC New Energy, the predecessor of GAC Aion.
history.event_zh: 成立广汽新能源（广汽埃安前身）。

history.event_en: At the Guangzhou Auto Show, GAC announces that the Aion brand will operate independently and that GAC New Energy is renamed GAC Aion New Energy Automobile Co., Ltd.
history.event_zh: 在广州车展上宣布「广汽埃安」品牌独立运营，广汽新能源更名为广汽埃安新能源汽车有限公司。

history.event_en: GAC Aion unveils the high-end Hyper (昊铂) brand, with the Hyper SSR electric supercar making its debut.
history.event_zh: 广汽埃安发布高端品牌昊铂（Hyper），首款纯电超跑 Hyper SSR 亮相。

history.event_en: GAC Fiat Chrysler Automobiles (GAC FCA) files for bankruptcy after Stellantis moves to end the joint venture.
history.event_zh: 广汽菲亚特克莱斯勒（广汽菲克）在 Stellantis 终止合资后进入破产程序。

history.event_en: Announces the restructuring of GAC Mitsubishi: GAC buys Mitsubishi Motors' 30% and Mitsubishi Corp's 20% stakes for RMB1 each, making it a wholly owned subsidiary; Mitsubishi exits whole-vehicle production in China.
history.event_zh: 公告广汽三菱重组：广汽以 1 元对价分别受让三菱汽车 30%、三菱商事 20% 股权，重组后成为全资子公司；三菱退出中国整车业务。

history.event_en: The former GAC Mitsubishi Changsha plant, taken over and refitted by GAC Aion, is completed and put into production (21 August).
history.event_zh: 广汽埃安接管改造的原广汽三菱长沙工厂竣工投产（8 月 21 日）。

history.event_en: Moves headquarters to Panyu Auto City, launches the three-year 'Panyu Action' reform, and signs a deepened strategic cooperation agreement with Huawei.
history.event_zh: 总部迁至番禺汽车城，发布三年「番禺行动」改革计划，并与华为签署深化战略合作协议。

history.event_en: Chairman Zeng Qinghong retires at the statutory age; Feng Xingya is elected chairman (3 February).
history.event_zh: 董事长曾庆洪到龄退休，冯兴亚当选董事长（2 月 3 日）。

history.event_en: Xia Xianqing is appointed general manager under a new round of professional-manager appointments.
history.event_zh: 新一届职业经理人聘任落地，閤先庆出任总经理。

history.event_en: GAC and Huawei Qiankun hold the first brand launch for the premium intelligent NEV brand Qijing (AISTALAND); its first model, the GT7, debuts and opens blind orders.
history.event_zh: 广汽与华为乾崑联合举办高端智能新能源品牌启境（AISTALAND）首次品牌发布会，首款车型 GT7 亮相并开启盲订。

history.event_en: The Qijing GT7 goes on sale (RMB 209,900–329,900).
history.event_zh: 启境 GT7 正式上市（20.99 万–32.99 万元）。

history.event_en: Announces a plan to buy a 50% stake in FAW Toyota by issuing shares and raising matching funds; the transaction is still pending approvals.
history.event_zh: 发布发行股份购买资产预案，拟购买一汽丰田 50% 股权并募集配套资金；交易尚待审批。

brands.role_en: Self-owned mainstream passenger-car brand spanning sedans, SUVs and MPVs, including the high-end 'Xiangwang' NEV line.
brands.role_zh: 自主主流乘用车品牌，覆盖轿车、SUV、MPV，含高端「向往」新能源系列。
brands.owner_note_en: Operated by GAC Trumpchi Automobile Co., Ltd. (a wholly owned GAC subsidiary). Models include GS4, GS8, M8, M6, E8/E9 and the Xiangwang S-series (S7, S9, S8). 2025 sales were 319,200 units, down 23.02% year on year.
brands.owner_note_zh: 运营主体为广汽传祺汽车有限公司（广汽集团全资子公司）。车型包括 GS4、GS8、M8、M6、E8/E9 及向往 S7/S9/S8 系列。2025 年销量 31.92 万辆，同比下滑 23.02%。

brands.role_en: Self-owned new-energy passenger-car brand covering BEV and EREV models.
brands.role_zh: 自主新能源乘用车品牌，覆盖纯电与增程车型。
brands.owner_note_en: Operated by GAC Aion New Energy Automobile Co., Ltd., a GAC-controlled subsidiary that brought in external strategic investors in 2022. Models include AION S, Y, V, UT, RT and the i60 (BEV and EREV versions launched November 2025). 2025 sales were 290,100 units, down 22.62%.
brands.owner_note_zh: 运营主体为广汽埃安新能源汽车股份有限公司（广汽集团控股，2022 年引入外部战略投资者）。车型包括 AION S、Y、V、UT、RT 及 i60（纯电/增程版于 2025 年 11 月上市）。2025 年销量 29.01 万辆，同比下滑 22.62%。

brands.role_en: High-end new-energy brand (BEV plus EREV) under GAC Aion.
brands.role_zh: 广汽埃安旗下高端新能源品牌（纯电＋增程）。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched September 2022. Models include GT, HT, SSR, HL (an EREV version launched August 2025) and A800. In December 2025 GAC merged Hyptec and Aion into a single 'Hyptec-Aion BU' business unit.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2022 年 9 月发布。车型包括 GT、HT、SSR、HL（增程版于 2025 年 8 月上市）、A800。2025 年 12 月广汽将昊铂与埃安合并为「昊铂埃安 BU」。

brands.role_en: High-end intelligent NEV brand jointly created by GAC and Huawei Qiankun.
brands.role_zh: 广汽与华为乾崑联合打造的高端智能新能源品牌。
brands.owner_note_en: Officially announced on 19 September 2025 as a high-end intelligent NEV brand created by GAC and Huawei Qiankun: GAC leads manufacturing and quality, while Huawei supplies the full-stack intelligent solution (Qiankun ADS, HarmonySpace cockpit). The operating entity is Qijing Intelligent Automobile Technology (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd. (启境智能汽车科技（广州）有限公司), formerly Huawang Automobile Technology (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd., established in March 2025 with registered capital of RMB1.5 billion and renamed in March 2026; after a strategic capital increase of over RMB1 billion completed in May 2026 (bringing in CATL, Bosch and state-owned platforms), GAC Group and GAC Aion jointly hold about 69.65%. The first model, the GT7 (5,050×1,980×1,470 mm, 3,000 mm wheelbase), went on sale on 26 June 2026 at RMB 209,900–329,900; the second model, the GX7 five-seat SUV (5,099×2,006×1,750 mm, 3,070 mm wheelbase), went on sale on 23 September 2026 at limited-time prices of RMB 229,900–291,900.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2025 年 9 月 19 日正式官宣，为广汽集团与华为乾崑联合打造的高端智能新能源品牌：广汽主导制造与品控，华为提供全栈智能方案（乾崑 ADS、鸿蒙座舱）。运营主体为启境智能汽车科技（广州）有限公司，前称华望汽车技术（广州）有限公司，2025 年 3 月成立、注册资本 15 亿元，2026 年 3 月更名；2026 年 5 月完成超 10 亿元战略增资（引入宁德时代、博世及国央企平台）后，广汽集团与广汽埃安合计持股约 69.65%。首款车型 GT7（5050×1980×1470 毫米，轴距 3000 毫米）于 2026 年 6 月 26 日上市，售价 20.99 万–32.99 万元；第二款车型 GX7 五座 SUV（5099×2006×1750 毫米，轴距 3070 毫米）于 2026 年 9 月 23 日上市，限时权益价 22.99 万–29.19 万元。

brands.role_en: Passenger-car joint venture owned 50% by GAC and 50% collectively by Toyota group companies.
brands.role_zh: 广汽集团与丰田系合计各持股 50% 的乘用车合资公司。
brands.owner_note_en: Established 2004, owned 50% by GAC, 30.50% by Toyota Motor Corporation and 19.50% by Toyota Motor (China) Investment Co., Ltd.; Toyota group companies collectively hold 50%. Models include Camry, Highlander, Sienna, Wildlander and the bZ/BoZhi NEV line. 2025 sales were 756,000 units, up 2.44%.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2004 年成立，广汽集团持股 50%，丰田汽车公司持股 30.50%，丰田汽车（中国）投资有限公司持股 19.50%；丰田系合计持股 50%。车型包括凯美瑞、汉兰达、赛那、威兰达及铂智新能源系列。2025 年销量 75.6 万辆，同比增长 2.44%。

brands.role_zh: 与本田合资的乘用车公司。
brands.owner_note_en: Established 1998. GAC holds 50%; the Honda side holds the other 50%, split between Honda Motor Co., Ltd. (40%) and Honda Motor (China) Investment Co., Ltd. (10%). Models include Accord, Breeze, Avancier, Odyssey and Fit. On 10 November 2025 the partners signed an agreement to increase registered capital from USD541 million to USD867,215,960 (about USD867 million), with ownership remaining 50%/40%/10% upon completion. Honda Motor and Honda China would contribute their respective 40% and 10% stakes in Dongfeng Honda Engine. The 2025 annual report lists the increased registered capital. 2025 sales were 351,900 units, down 25.22%.
brands.owner_note_zh: 1998 年成立。广汽集团持股 50%；本田方面合计持股 50%，其中本田技研工业株式会社直接持股 40%、本田技研工业（中国）投资有限公司持股 10%。车型包括雅阁、皓影、冠道、奥德赛、飞度。2025 年 11 月 10 日各方签署增资协议，约定注册资本由 5.41 亿美元增至 867,215,960 美元（约 8.67 亿美元），完成后股比维持 50%／40%／10%；本田技研工业及本田中国分别以所持东风本田发动机 40%、10% 股权作价出资。2025 年年报已列示上述增资后的注册资本。2025 年销量 35.19 万辆，同比下滑 25.22%。

brands.role_en: Commercial-vehicle business, including heavy trucks, new-energy light trucks, buses and pickups.
brands.role_zh: 商用车业务，产品覆盖重卡、新能源轻卡、客车及皮卡等。
brands.owner_note_en: Operated by GAC Lingcheng New Energy Commercial Vehicle Co., Ltd., formerly GAC Hino Motors Co., Ltd., registered in November 2007. It became a GAC-controlled subsidiary in September 2024; GAC directly held 90% at end-2025. The founding year refers to the predecessor entity.
brands.owner_note_zh: 运营主体为广汽领程新能源商用车有限公司，前称广汽日野汽车有限公司，2007 年 11 月注册成立，2024 年 9 月变更为广汽集团控股子公司；截至 2025 年末广汽集团直接持股 90%。成立年份按前身企业口径。

brands.role_en: Motorcycle joint venture serving commuting and leisure mobility, including electric two-wheelers.
brands.role_zh: 摩托车合资业务，覆盖城市通勤、日常代步与休闲出行及电动两轮产品。
brands.owner_note_en: Wuyang-Honda Motors (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd. was registered in July 1992. It manufactures and sells motorcycles and related parts. GAC directly held 50% at end-2025; the annual report identifies Honda Motor and Honda China as the other joint-venture partners.
brands.owner_note_zh: 主体为五羊－本田摩托（广州）有限公司，1992 年 7 月注册成立，从事摩托车及相关零部件生产、销售。截至 2025 年末广汽集团直接持股 50%；年报列明其他合资方为本田技研工业株式会社及本田技研工业（中国）投资有限公司。

brands.role_en: Former joint venture, restructured into a wholly owned GAC subsidiary in 2023-2024.
brands.role_zh: 原合资公司，2023–2024 年重组为广汽集团全资子公司。
brands.owner_note_en: Established 2012, originally held 50% by GAC, 30% by Mitsubishi Motors and 20% by Mitsubishi Corp. In October 2023 GAC bought out the Japanese stakes for RMB1 each; the Changsha plant was transferred to GAC Aion (equipment sold, land and buildings leased) and was completed and put into production on 21 August 2024.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2012 年成立，原股比广汽集团 50%、三菱汽车 30%、三菱商事 20%。2023 年 10 月广汽以 1 元对价受让日方股权，成为全资子公司；长沙工厂由广汽埃安接手（设备出售、土地厂房租赁），于 2024 年 8 月 21 日竣工投产。

brands.role_en: Former joint venture with Fiat Chrysler (Stellantis), bankrupted in 2022.
brands.role_zh: 原与菲亚特克莱斯勒（Stellantis）合资的公司，2022 年破产。
brands.owner_note_en: Founded March 2010 as GAC Fiat, renamed GAC FCA in 2015. After Stellantis moved to end the JV, GAC FCA filed for bankruptcy in late 2022.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2010 年 3 月成立（广汽菲亚特），2015 年更名广汽菲克。Stellantis 终止合资后，广汽菲克于 2022 年申请破产。

brands.role_en: Former GAC-NIO collaboration (GAC-NIO), later controlled by Zhujiang Investment, now distressed.
brands.role_zh: 原广汽与蔚来合作的广汽蔚来，后由珠江投管入主，现陷入经营困境。
brands.owner_note_en: Predecessor GAC-NIO was set up in April 2018 with GAC holding 45%, NIO 45% and the founding team 10%. The Hycan brand was released in 2019. After a 2021 capital increase, Zhujiang Investment became the largest shareholder and the company was renamed Hycan; NIO exited in 2022. In 2024–2025 Hycan faced severe operating difficulties, and in January 2025 GAC arranged employee settlement with GAC Aion taking over after-sales service.
brands.owner_note_zh: 前身广汽蔚来于 2018 年 4 月成立，股比广汽方 45%、蔚来方 45%、核心团队 10%；2019 年发布合创品牌。2021 年增资后珠江投管成为第一大股东并更名合创汽车，2022 年蔚来退出。2024–2025 年陷入严重经营困难，2025 年 1 月广汽按出资比例解决员工安置、由广汽埃安接管售后。

financials.note_en: Unit: million yuan (CNY), consolidated financial statements under PRC GAAP (Chinese Accounting Standards). Revenue is operating revenue (营业收入): RMB75.11bn (2021), 109.60bn (2022), 128.76bn (2023), 106.80bn (2024) and 95.66bn (2025); the 2021 figure uses the three-year comparative in the 2023 annual report summary. Net profit is profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company (归属于母公司股东的净利润). R&D is disclosed total R&D investment including capitalised development expenditure. Gross margin is calculated as (operating revenue minus operating cost) divided by operating revenue: 6.05% (2023), 5.80% (2024) and -1.33% (2025). The 2024 annual report (s2, p. 148) states that CAS Interpretation No. 18 was applied from 1 January 2024, reclassifying relevant assurance-type warranty expenses from selling expenses to operating cost and restating the 2023 comparative. The 2023 margin uses that restated comparative; the 2024–2025 margins use the same warranty-cost classification. The 2021–2022 gross margins are null because comparable figures restated for this reclassification have not been verified in a primary source; margins on the earlier basis are omitted from this table. The warranty-cost reclassification does not change revenue, net profit or total R&D investment. Each row cites the annual reports supporting its figures.
financials.note_zh: 单位：百万元人民币，合并报表，中国企业会计准则。营业收入为利润表的「营业收入」：2021 年 751.10 亿元、2022 年 1096.00 亿元、2023 年 1287.57 亿元、2024 年 1067.98 亿元、2025 年 956.62 亿元；其中 2021 年采用 2023 年年度报告摘要披露的三年比较数据。净利润为「归属于上市公司股东（母公司股东）的净利润」。研发投入为公司披露的研发投入合计，含资本化开发支出。毛利率按（营业收入 − 营业成本）÷ 营业收入计算：2023 年 6.05%、2024 年 5.80%、2025 年 -1.33%。2024 年年报（s2，第 148 页）披露，自 2024 年 1 月 1 日执行《企业会计准则解释第18号》，将相关保证类质量保证费用由销售费用改列营业成本，并重述 2023 年比较数。2023 年毛利率采用该重述比较数，2024–2025 年采用相同的质保费用分类口径。2021–2022 年未在一手出处中核实按此次重分类重述的可比毛利率，故均留为 null，表内不列示旧口径毛利率。该质保费用重分类不改变营业收入、净利润及研发投入合计。各行 source_ids 对应支持该行数据的年度报告。

overview.en:
Guangzhou Automobile Group Co., Ltd. (GAC Group, 广汽集团) is a Guangzhou-headquartered, state-controlled automaker and mobility group. Its predecessor Guangzhou Automobile Group was founded in June 1997 and was restructured into a joint-stock company on 28 June 2005; the group listed in Hong Kong in 2010 and Shanghai in 2012, becoming the first large state-controlled Chinese auto group with an overall A+H listing [s12][s53][s33]. Its business spans R&D, whole vehicles (automobiles and motorcycles), components, trading and mobility, the energy ecosystem, internationalisation, and investment and finance [s1]. Its self-owned brands are GAC Motor (Trumpchi), GAC Aion (including Hyptec) and the Huawei-collaborated premium brand Qijing, alongside the two core joint ventures GAC Toyota and GAC Honda [s8].

In 2025 GAC reported operating revenue of RMB95.66 billion and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB8.78 billion, with group vehicle sales of 1.72 million units, down 14.06% year on year [s1]. At end-2025 the group employed 82,067 people, and in July 2026 it produced its 30-millionth vehicle, the fifth Chinese automaker group to reach that milestone [s1][s34].
overview.zh:
广州汽车集团股份有限公司（广汽集团）是一家总部位于广州的国有控股整车制造与出行服务集团，前身广州汽车集团成立于 1997 年 6 月，2005 年 6 月 28 日整体改制为股份有限公司，2010 年、2012 年先后在港交所与上交所上市，是国内首家实现 A+H 股整体上市的大型国有控股汽车集团 [s12][s53][s33]。业务覆盖研发、整车（汽车、摩托车）、零部件、商贸与出行、能源生态、国际化、投资与金融等板块 [s1]。自主品牌为广汽传祺、广汽埃安（含昊铂）以及与华为合作的高端品牌启境，并经营广汽丰田、广汽本田两大核心合资公司 [s8]。

2025 年广汽集团营业收入 956.62 亿元，归母净利润亏损 87.84 亿元，全年汽车销量 172.15 万辆、同比下滑 14.06% [s1]。截至 2025 年末集团员工 82,067 人；2026 年 7 月第 3000 万辆整车下线，为国内第五家达成该里程碑的车企集团 [s1][s34]。

current.en:
Business structure

For full-year 2025 GAC's operating revenue was RMB95.66 billion; whole-vehicle manufacturing revenue was RMB69.01 billion, down 12.57% year on year, and automotive business and related trading revenue was RMB91.47 billion [s1]. In the first half of 2026 the group reported operating revenue (营业收入) of RMB46.12 billion, up 9.38% year on year, and total operating income (营业总收入) of RMB46.50 billion, up 9.13% [s5]. By segment, whole-vehicle manufacturing contributed RMB31.83 billion, trading and services RMB8.94 billion, finance and others RMB3.28 billion and components RMB2.45 billion, equal to 68.45%, 19.23%, 7.04% and 5.28% of the RMB46.50 billion total operating income respectively [s5]. H1 2026 net loss attributable to shareholders was RMB4.47 billion, versus RMB2.54 billion a year earlier; at end-2025 the debt-to-asset ratio was 48.97% and operating cash flow was RMB -15.03 billion [s5][s1].

Sales trajectory

Group vehicle sales rose from 2.1444 million units in 2021 to 2.4338 million in 2022 and a peak of 2.505 million in 2023, then fell to 2.0031 million in 2024 and 1.7215 million in 2025 [s39][s40][s41][s1]. Self-owned brand sales rose from 633,700 units in 2022 to 886,500 in 2023, then fell to 609,200 units in 2025, down 22.83% year on year [s40][s41][s25]. GAC ranked fourth among Chinese automakers by production and sales in 2022 (about 9.1% share) and fifth in 2023 (about 8.32% share) [s40][s41].

Self-owned brand reform (Panyu Action)

Since late 2024 GAC has pursued a three-year self-owned-brand reform known as the 'Panyu Action': it set up shared service centres, introduced IPD (integrated product development) and IPMS (integrated product marketing and sales) processes, formed product commercialisation teams, and piloted business-unit (BU) structures, resulting in a 'Hyptec-Aion BU' and a 'Trumpchi BU' (established in January 2026) that integrate R&D, manufacturing, sales and service under unified command [s32][s34][s1].

Core technology platforms

GAC's self-developed technology stack includes the 'Magazine Battery' (弹匣电池) safety system, now in its 2.0 generation, the Quark electric drive and the Xingling (星灵) electronic and electrical architecture; in the first half of 2026 the group released the latest Xingling 4.0 architecture together with the new Xingyuan powertrain, Xingjian body and Xinghe cockpit [s49]. In H1 2026 R&D investment was RMB4.834 billion, up 27.58% year on year, equivalent to about 10.4% of total operating income of RMB46.50 billion (calculated here) [s5]. The 2025 annual report sets out a plan for small-volume installation of all-solid-state batteries in 2026 [s1].

Factories and capacity

The 2025 annual report lists annual design capacity of 600,000, 1,000,000, 720,000, 560,000 and 10,000 vehicles for GAC Honda, GAC Toyota, GAC Trumpchi, GAC Aion and GAC Lingcheng respectively; corresponding utilisation rates were 59%, 76%, 46%, 54% and 45%. Summing these five entries gives 2.89 million vehicles per year, a total calculated here from the individual disclosures. The report defines design capacity as effective capacity on a two-shift basis; its column labelled capacity during the reporting period actually denotes production volume [s1]. The former GAC Mitsubishi Changsha plant, taken over and refitted by GAC Aion, was completed and put into production on 21 August 2024 [s16]. By H1 2026 the group had seven overseas knocked-down (KD) assembly plants [s5].

Overseas business

In H1 2026 overseas revenue was RMB14.01 billion, up 109.27% year on year, and self-owned-brand exports reached 121,500 units, up 132% [s5]. The group entered 32 new overseas markets in H1 2026, covering 110 countries and regions globally [s49]. Its 2026 target is 250,000 overseas units, and its 2030 goal is to be present in 120 countries with overseas annual sales of over one million units [s1][s49]. In 2025 self-owned-brand overseas sales were nearly 130,000 units on an export retail basis [s59].
current.zh:
业务结构

2025 年全年广汽集团营业收入 956.62 亿元，其中整车制造收入 690.10 亿元、同比下滑 12.57%，汽车业务及相关贸易收入 914.66 亿元 [s1]。2026 年上半年集团营业收入 461.21 亿元、同比增长 9.38%，营业总收入 465.00 亿元、同比增长 9.13% [s5]。按主营构成，整车制造收入 318.31 亿元、商贸服务 89.40 亿元、金融及其他 32.75 亿元、零部件制造 24.54 亿元，分别占营业总收入 465.00 亿元的 68.45%、19.23%、7.04%、5.28% [s5]。2026 年上半年归母净利润为 -44.67 亿元，上年同期为 -25.38 亿元；截至 2025 年末资产负债率 48.97%，2025 年经营活动现金流量净额为 -150.26 亿元 [s5][s1]。

近年销量

集团汽车销量由 2021 年的 214.44 万辆增至 2022 年的 243.38 万辆，2023 年达峰值 250.5 万辆，随后回落至 2024 年的 200.31 万辆、2025 年的 172.15 万辆 [s39][s40][s41][s1]。自主品牌销量由 2022 年的 63.37 万辆增至 2023 年的 88.65 万辆，2025 年回落至 60.92 万辆、同比下滑 22.83% [s40][s41][s25]。2022 年广汽产销规模升至行业第四、市占率约 9.1%，2023 年位列中国车企前五、市占率约 8.32% [s40][s41]。

自主品牌改革（番禺行动）

2024 年底起广汽推动三年期自主品牌一体化改革（「番禺行动」）：设立共享中心，导入 IPD（集成产品开发）与 IPMS（集成产品营销与销售）流程，组建产品商业化团队，推进 BU（事业部）组织试点，形成「昊铂埃安 BU」与「传祺 BU」（2026 年 1 月成立）的双 BU 格局，实现研发、制造、销售与服务一体化运营、统一指挥 [s32][s34][s1]。

核心技术平台

广汽自研技术体系包括「弹匣电池」（Magazine Battery，已迭代至 2.0）、夸克电驱、星灵电子电气架构等；2026 年上半年集中发布星源动力、星舰车身、星河智舱、星灵架构 4.0 等最新成果 [s49]。2026 年上半年研发投入 48.34 亿元、同比增长 27.58%，相当于同期营业总收入 465.00 亿元的约 10.4%（本页计算）[s5]。公司在 2025 年年报中提出 2026 年全固态电池小批量装车计划 [s1]。

工厂与产能

2025 年年报“产能状况”列示，广汽本田、广汽丰田、广汽传祺、广汽埃安、广汽领程的设计产能分别为 60、100、72、56、1 万辆／年，产能利用率分别为 59%、76%、46%、54%、45%。上述五家工厂设计产能加总为 289 万辆／年，为本页按年报分项计算的合计；年报注明设计产能为实际有效产能，以两班制标准产能计算，“报告期内产能”实际指报告期内产量 [s1]。原广汽三菱长沙工厂由广汽埃安接管改造，于 2024 年 8 月 21 日竣工投产 [s16]。截至 2026 年上半年，集团已布局 7 座海外 KD（散件组装）工厂 [s5]。

海外业务

2026 年上半年，境外收入 140.13 亿元、同比增长 109.27%，自主品牌出口量 12.15 万辆、同比增长 132% [s5]。上半年新拓展 32 个海外市场，全球业务覆盖 110 个国家和地区 [s49]。2026 年目标海外销量 25 万辆，2030 年目标进入全球 120 个国家和地区、海外年销突破 100 万辆 [s1][s49]。2025 年自主品牌汽车出口终端销量近 13 万辆 [s59]。

leadership.en:
Chairman and general manager

Feng Xingya (冯兴亚), born 1969, holds an MBA from Xi'an Jiaotong University. He worked for 16 years at Zhengzhou Light Vehicle Works and Zhengzhou Nissan across production, procurement, sales and management, joined GAC Toyota in December 2004 as the Chinese sales lead, became a GAC Group vice president in July 2008, executive vice president in 2013 and general manager in November 2016. He was elected chairman in February 2025 after predecessor Zeng Qinghong retired at the statutory age, and served concurrently as general manager until November 2025; he is now party secretary and chairman [s9].

Xia Xianqing (閤先庆) [s58], born 1973, graduated from Tongji University's mechanical engineering department. He previously served as vice president of GAC Honda, chairman and general manager of GAC Trading, and GAC Group vice president; in November 2025 he was appointed general manager [s20]. He concurrently chairs GAC Toyota, GAC Aion and Qijing Automobile (formerly Huawang Automobile) [s20][s48]. In January 2026 he stepped down as chairman and legal representative of GAC Trumpchi Automobile Co., Ltd., succeeded by Huang Jian, who also became president of the newly formed Trumpchi BU [s50].

Other senior management

As of the official leadership page, the other executives are Gao Rui (executive vice president), Wang Dan (chief accountant and finance head), and vice presidents Jiang Xiuyun and Chen Jiacai, alongside deputy party secretary Cao Xiaojun, discipline secretary Zheng Dantong, union chair Deng Lei and board secretary Liu Xiangneng [s7]. Chen Jiacai was hired externally with overseas-market experience at Seres and Chery Jetour [s20]. Vice president Huang Yongqiang (born October 1974, formerly GAC Toyota vice president and GAC Trumpchi deputy party secretary and general manager), appointed in November 2025, left the post on 14 May 2026 due to an organisational work re-assignment; vice president Zheng Heng left on 24 December 2025 [s10][s21][s48].

Former chairman

Zeng Qinghong started as an auto repair worker at Guangzhou Bus Works and worked in the auto industry for over 40 years, holding several posts including GAC vice chairman; he served as party secretary and chairman from 2016 until retiring on 3 February 2025 [s19].

Ownership and governance

At end-2025 the largest shareholder was Guangzhou Automobile Industry Group Co., Ltd. with 54.02%, followed by HKSCC NOMINEES LIMITED (27.56%, H-share nominees), Guangzhou Huiyin Tianyue (3.88%) and Guangzhou Industrial Investment Holdings Group (1.41%); the actual controller is Guangzhou SASAC [s1]. GAC has run a professional-manager system since 2018 [s20].
leadership.zh:
董事长与总经理

冯兴亚，1969 年生，西安交通大学工商管理硕士。先后在郑州轻型汽车制造厂、郑州日产等企业历经生产、采购、销售、综合管理等多岗位锻炼 16 年，2004 年 12 月加入广汽丰田任销售部门中方负责人，2008 年 7 月任广汽集团副总经理，2013 年任常务副总经理，2016 年 11 月任总经理。2025 年 2 月在曾庆洪到龄退休后当选董事长，并兼任总经理至 2025 年 11 月，现任公司党委书记、董事长 [s9]。

閤先庆 [s58]，1973 年生，同济大学机械工程系毕业。曾任广汽本田副总经理、广汽商贸董事长兼总经理、广汽集团副总经理，2025 年 11 月在新一届职业经理人聘任中出任总经理 [s20]。他兼任广汽丰田、广汽埃安、启境汽车（前称华望汽车）董事长 [s20][s48]。2026 年 1 月，他卸任广汽传祺汽车有限公司法定代表人、董事长，由黄坚接任，黄坚同时出任新成立的传祺 BU 总裁 [s50]。

其他核心管理层

据公司官网领导班子页面，现任其他高管为：高锐任常务副总经理；王丹任总会计师、财务负责人；江秀云、陈家才任副总经理；另有党委副书记曹晓军、纪委书记郑丹彤、工会主席邓蕾、董事会秘书刘祥能 [s7]。陈家才为外部引进，具赛力斯、奇瑞捷途海外业务经验 [s20]。副总经理黄永强（1974 年 10 月生，曾任广汽丰田副总经理、广汽传祺党委副书记兼总经理）2025 年 11 月获聘，2026 年 5 月 14 日因组织上工作安排离任；副总经理郑衡于 2025 年 12 月 24 日离任 [s10][s21][s48]。

前任董事长

曾庆洪从广州客车厂汽车修理工做起，在汽车行业工作 40 余年，历任多个职务及广汽副董事长，2016 年起任广汽集团党委书记、董事长，2025 年 2 月 3 日因到龄离任 [s19]。

股权与治理

截至 2025 年末，第一大股东为广州汽车工业集团有限公司，持股 54.02%，其次为 HKSCC NOMINEES LIMITED（27.56%，H 股代持）、广州汇垠天粤（3.88%）、广州产业投资控股集团（1.41%）；实际控制人为广州市国资委 [s1]。广汽自 2018 年起推行职业经理人制度 [s20]。

competition.en: Our judgment.In self-owned passenger cars, GAC competes with groups including BYD, Geely, Changan, Chery and Great Wall Motor; its joint ventures compete with other Japanese-brand JVs. This assessment is based on the passenger-car products and business structure of Trumpchi, Aion and the two Japanese JVs [s1]. GAC has an established manufacturing system and self-owned brands, but sales, profitability and capacity utilisation indicate operating pressure: 2025 group vehicle sales fell 14.06%, gross margin calculated from the consolidated income statement was about -1.33%, and Trumpchi and Aion plant utilisation was 46% and 54%. The two core JVs diverged: GAC Toyota sales rose 2.44%, while GAC Honda sales fell 25.22%. They cannot both be described as shrinking, and JV volumes cannot be equated with consolidated group revenue. Our judgment is that GAC must address self-owned-brand scale, plant utilisation and joint-venture earnings together [s1].
competition.zh: 我们的判断。在自主乘用车市场，广汽与比亚迪、吉利、长安、奇瑞、长城等集团形成竞争；合资业务则与其他日系合资车企竞争。依据是广汽传祺、埃安及两家日系合资公司覆盖的乘用车产品与业务结构 [s1]。广汽的制造体系和自主品牌布局提供转型基础，但销量、盈利与产能利用率显示经营压力：2025 年集团汽车销量同比下降 14.06%，按合并利润表计算的毛利率约 -1.33%，传祺、埃安产能利用率分别为 46%、54%；两家核心合资公司的走势有分化，广汽丰田销量同比增长 2.44%，广汽本田下降 25.22%。因此，不能将两家合资公司概括为同步收缩，也不能将合资企业销量直接等同于集团合并营业收入。我们的判断是，广汽的转型需同时处理自主品牌规模、工厂利用率和合资企业收益三方面压力 [s1]。

outlook.en:
Company targets. In its official statement dated 23 December 2024, GAC reaffirmed the three-year 'Panyu Action' targets: self-owned brands to exceed 60% of group sales and challenge 2 million units by 2027 [s57]. The cited report says Huawei Qiankun has stationed a team in Guangzhou and introduced its IPD and IPMS processes, and in January 2026 GAC signed a comprehensive cooperation framework agreement with Huawei Device [s22]. For 2026 the company targets 250,000 overseas units and plans small-volume installation of all-solid-state batteries [s1]. Several new models were launched during 2026: the Hyptec A800 (4 March), the Aion N60 (28 April), the Qijing GT7 (26 June) and the Qijing GX7 large SUV (23 September) [s5][s51]. In September 2026 it announced a plan to buy a 50% stake in FAW Toyota via a share issue, a transaction still pending approvals [s29].

Our judgment. A turnaround rests on three premises: that the Japanese joint ventures stabilise their margins, that self-owned new-energy brands (including Qijing and Hyptec) scale up, and that overseas growth sustains its pace. The main alternative scenario is continued domestic price competition eroding per-vehicle profit while joint-venture investment income keeps shrinking. This is our judgment, not a forecast of share-price performance, based on the reported financial data above [s1].
outlook.zh:
公司公开目标。广汽 2024 年 12 月 23 日官网公告重申三年「番禺行动」目标：到 2027 年自主品牌占集团总销量超 60%、挑战 200 万辆 [s57]。据该报道，华为乾崑派驻团队常驻广州、引入 IPD 与 IPMS 流程，2026 年 1 月广汽又与华为终端签署全面合作框架协议 [s22]。2026 年公司目标海外销量 25 万辆，并计划全固态电池小批量装车 [s1]。2026 年内已有多款新车上市：昊铂 A800（3 月 4 日）、埃安 N60（4 月 28 日）、启境 GT7（6 月 26 日）、启境 GX7 中大型 SUV（9 月 23 日）[s5][s51]。2026 年 9 月，公司公告拟发行股份购买一汽丰田 50% 股权，该交易尚待审批 [s29]。

我们的判断。经营企稳依赖三个前提：日系合资毛利率企稳、自主新能源品牌（包括启境、昊铂）放量、海外增长得以持续。另一种主要情形是国内价格竞争持续侵蚀单车利润，同时合资公司投资收益继续收缩。以上为我们的判断，不构成股价预测，依据为前述披露财务数据 [s1]。

risks.en:
• Price competition and margin pressure. Overall gross margin turned negative in 2025 (about -1.33%), with the whole-vehicle manufacturing segment margin at about -7.35% [s1].
  • Lower joint-venture earnings. GAC Honda's 2025 sales fell 25.22%, and the group's share of profits from joint ventures and associates fell to RMB2.485 billion in 2025, down 17.11% from RMB2.998 billion a year earlier [s1].
  • Asset impairment. GAC made asset impairment provisions of RMB2.747 billion in 2025, mainly inventory write-downs (RMB1.223 billion) and intangible-asset impairments (RMB1.246 billion) [s6].
  • Self-owned brands and capacity utilisation.GAC Trumpchi and GAC Aion utilisation rates were 46% and 54% in 2025 [s1].
  • Foreign-exchange exposure. H1 2026 overseas revenue grew rapidly, and exchange-rate fluctuations contributed to the widened loss [s5].
risks.zh:
• 价格竞争与利润率压力。2025 年综合毛利率转负（约 -1.33%），整车制造业务毛利率约 -7.35% [s1]。
  • 合资企业收益下降。广汽本田 2025 年销量下滑 25.22%，公司对联营企业和合营企业的投资收益为 24.85 亿元、同比下降 17.11%（上年 29.98 亿元）[s1]。
  • 资产减值。2025 年广汽计提资产减值准备 27.47 亿元，主要为存货跌价准备 12.23 亿元、无形资产减值 12.46 亿元 [s6]。
  • 自主品牌与产能利用率。2025 年广汽传祺、广汽埃安的产能利用率分别为 46%、54% [s1]。
  • 汇率风险。2026 年上半年境外收入快速增长，汇兑损失加剧亏损 [s5]。
